name: DeepSeek
shortDescription: DeepSeek chat app and API models for chat, coding, and web search.
longDescription: DeepSeek publishes a chat app and an API. The app is free, with no ads or in-app purchases, and includes web search, a deep-think mode, and file upload. It is the official assistant for chat. The API docs list deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro, with tool calls and a beta fill-in-the-middle completion used for code. API prices are per million tokens.
pricingNotes: The API docs price deepseek-flash input at $0.15 per million tokens off-peak on a cache miss and $0.30 at peak. Output is $0.60 off-peak and $1.20 at peak. deepseek-v4-pro is higher on the same table. The app announcement says the chat app is free.
freeTierNotes: The official app announcement says the chat app is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. The API is billed per token.
bestFor: Chat in the free DeepSeek app, including web search and deep-think mode
Coding through the API, including tool calls and fill-in-the-middle completion
notIdealFor: A reviewed look at the live chat screen
A self-hosted copy of the current API models
strength: The official app announcement says DeepSeek chat is free, with web search and no in-app purchases.
weakness: The chat website did not open, so the live app screen is not described.
smokeTestNotes: The app announcement, download page, and API docs were reviewed. The chat website did not open.

useCaseFit.coding-agents: API docs include tool calls and fill-in-the-middle completion for code.
